parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4665541. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4665541'. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
